reader.requirement: At 85 every position of a print line that no printable item occupies (before the first item, between items, on every line of a multi-line group) holds a space character. The witness covers one leading and one interior gap.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition/Year/DialectLevel/DialectBehaviors in CobolReport.NewLine, CobolReport.Place and ReportLineImage (constructor Array.Fill ' ', Write, ToString): none; the line image is space-filled the same way at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: one leading and one interior gap (g85_z01); not multi-line groups, gaps after edited or signed items, or a VALUE SPACE item

probes.printed: od: 'Q1' 0x20 0x20 'AB' then five 0x20 '-  5' 0x20 '*'; '   L2   007'; '  Z': every gap is 0x20
D1 ' XYZ' then CR LF: the trailing spaces of the X(8) item (columns 5-9) are not written
probes.expected: a trailing position is not an unoccupied interior position; the record shape is implementor-defined

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.11.4 GR3  (3.11.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3

reader.notes: ReportLineImage starts as all spaces and Place overwrites only item columns, so every unoccupied position before and between items is a space. Doubt: the file writer trims trailing spaces from each line (FileConnector.TrimRecordEnd), so ' XYZ     ' is written as ' XYZ'. That is invisible on a printed page but contradicts DOC-A.1-159's 'a line holds exactly the columns its report group description places'; it concerns the documented representation rather than GR3, and is the same at 2023.

refuter.evidence: COLJB's second detail has a suppressed GROUP INDICATE item, a BLANK WHEN ZERO zero and a JUSTIFIED item. Every position outside the printed characters is 0x20 up to the '|' at column 22 (cat -A shows no stray bytes), and a shorter control-footing line printed after a wider detail line carries no stale characters. Trailing-space trimming is not a breach: §1985:XIII.3.2.4 GR2 says the report file's logical record structure 'is defined by the implementor'. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.11.4 GR3.
